verdict: Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads over the past 28 days, so organic GBP activity is carrying all engagement with 142 total actions including 48 calls and 94 web clicks. The biggest movement is a 100% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days, likely driven by a listing issue or a pause in profile activity that cut off what had been the sole source of inbound traffic.

performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark 28 days; GBP now collapsed — organic lifeline severed.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both $0 — means the entire lead engine is offline with 0 leads generated.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days; series confirms zero actions for 8 consecutive days (Aug 23–30), down from a peak of 19 on Aug 19.
Contract extension with Marwan is open and unresolved per SOW; without it the next 3-month scope — and any paid relaunch — has no authorization to proceed.
Search clicks rose +18.9% (7d delta) and GA4 sessions held near baseline (~42–64/day last week), signaling organic SEO interest exists but no paid or GBP channel is capturing it.
GHL shows 23 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in 28 days — with no paid leads arriving, pipeline is stale and intake cannot be evaluated.

suggestions.text: Resolve Marwan contract extension immediately — no paid relaunch is authorized until signed.
suggestions.monday_update: The engagement extension with Marwan is open and is blocking all paid activity. Zero spend and zero leads have been recorded across all 28 days (Meta $0, Google $0). Sohib to chase Marwan for signature this week. Success is confirmed when a signed extension is on file and the paid relaunch brief is approved — target by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing — 8 consecutive zero-action days after a 19-action peak on Aug 19 signals a listing suspension or profile issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 8 straight days (Aug 23–30), collapsing from 19 actions on Aug 19 — the sole remaining inbound channel is now dark. Search clicks are up 18.9% week-over-week, meaning organic demand exists but nothing is capturing it. Check Google Business Profile for suspension notices, ownership issues, or policy flags and restore the listing. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return above 5 for 3 consecutive days — recheck 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Watch SC clicks trend — up 18.9% — for 3 more days to confirm sustained organic intent before any paid relaunch targeting is scoped.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks rose 18.9% in the last 7-day window despite zero paid activity, suggesting sustained organic search demand. No paid budget is available to act on this yet pending contract resolution. Monitor SC clicks daily; if the trend holds above the current baseline for 3 more days, flag to Hamza/Hamdan as a targeting signal for the Meta relaunch. Recheck 2026-09-03.
